title: versions are plans of feature slices that can change without breaking

criteria.text: A feature has slices, each with its own horizon, rank and the conditions it waits on
A version is a record: outcomes, appetite, slices in and out, each leave-out with a reason and the condition that brings it back
No feature or slice carries a date; a version may
criteria.note: Built in #1241 (due_on refused on kinds it does not belong to) [V]. Checked: `[guards F127.3]` in `supabase/tests/knowledge_plans.sql`.

criteria.text: A change of plan is a new version with a why naming the outcome that changed; the earlier plan stays readable
One call each: what a version held on any date, and what changed between two dates, with the whys
criteria.note: `plan` and `plan_changes` verbs in #1241 [V]. Checked: `[guards F127.5]` in `supabase/tests/knowledge_plans.sql`.

criteria.text: Left out is not forgotten: a left-out slice is listed again when its condition is met or its outcome changes
Today's plan comes in: each scenario becomes a feature with one slice carrying horizon and rank
Nothing breaks: the dashboard and `STATUS.md` are generated from the store after a week side by side with today's generators
criteria.note: Not built [V]: #1241 PR body 'F127.8 ... #1242'. #1242 (open) needs a nightly compare job, then seven clean days, then the switch.
